  that way — #1310's acceptance criteria are
  the template ("a decision is recorded," not
  "the code is changed"). Hub gets a question,
  not a file.

  One thing I'll keep pushing on without
  needing to ask again: folding in duplication
  without fixing the contract lets it regrow.
  /api/auth/me publishing an empty response
  schema while actually returning roles is the
  mechanism that created the duplicate client
  in the first place. So platform's swagger
  audit stays a live thread rather than
  closing with #1309 — otherwise we
  consolidate today and rediscover the same
  shape in three months.

  Nothing dispatched. Both workers stay on
  what they have.
